user.title: Neil Connect
user.description: Select a Neil climatizador. Disconnect the official app first (only one phone can hold the BLE connection). On first setup, power the remote off and hold + and − for 5 seconds until the Bluetooth icon blinks.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Neil Connect
bluetooth_confirm.description: Connect to {name}. Disconnect the official Neil Connect app before continuing. On first setup, power the remote off and hold + and − for 5 seconds until the Bluetooth icon blinks.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the climatizador. It may be out of range, or another phone may still be connected.
error.pairing_failed: The remote must be in pair mode (hold + and − for 5 seconds while off). Another phone may still be connected.

init.title: Neil Connect
init.description: Optional. The climatizador has no temperature probe. With a sensor, the climate card shows that temperature and a target, and Cool cycles the pump to hold it. Clear the sensor to hide the target.

abort.no_devices_found: No MAXICLIMA devices found. Put the remote in pair mode and disconnect the official app.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the climatizador. It may be out of range, or another phone may still be connected.
abort.pairing_failed: The remote must be in pair mode (hold + and − for 5 seconds while off). Another phone may still be connected.

service_due.title: {name}: preventive maintenance due
service_due.description:
{name} has reached 300 hours of use since the last preventive maintenance. Remove the white shell, clear the spray-tube orifices, wash the evaporator filter with water (no chemicals), clean the pre-cooling sensors and the humidifier pump filter, and check the pump flow at minimum fan speed (it should fill a small cup). Then press Reset maintenance.

Manual: https://neil.com.ar/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Manual-de-Uso-e-Instalacion-Linea-Slim-_ARG_V02-Connect.pdf
Maintenance: https://neil.com.ar/soporte-tecnico/mantenimiento/

filter_due.title: {name}: evaporator filter replacement due
filter_due.description:
{name} has reached 900 hours of use since the evaporator filter was last replaced. Replace the filter and do the 300 hour service too. Reset filter replacement and maintenance clears both counters.

Manual: https://neil.com.ar/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Manual-de-Uso-e-Instalacion-Linea-Slim-_ARG_V02-Connect.pdf
Maintenance: https://neil.com.ar/soporte-tecnico/mantenimiento/
